// Fixture for audit_test.sh: every check of audit.sh fires here a known
// number of times. Not compiled (the .txt suffix keeps it out of the module).
package repo

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/coregx/relica"
)

type DB struct{ db *relica.DB }

// H1 ×1
func (d *DB) With(ctx context.Context) *relica.DB { return d.db }

func h2(db *relica.DB) {
	// H2 ×1
	db.Update("accounts").Set(map[string]any{"balance": "balance - ?"}).Where(relica.Eq("id", 1)).Execute()
}

func h3(ctx context.Context, db *relica.DB) {
	// H3 ×1
	tx, err := db.Begin(ctx)
	defer tx.Rollback()
	_ = err
}

func m1(err error) bool {
	// M1 ×1
	return strings.Contains(err.Error(), "duplicate key")
}

func m2(db *relica.DB) {
	// M2 ×1
	db.Select().From("t").Where("name ILIKE ?", "x").All(nil)
}

func m4(db *relica.DB) {
	// M4 ×1
	db.Transactional(context.Background(), nil)
}

func m5(table string) string {
	// M5 ×1
	return fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM %s", table)
}

func m6(db *relica.DB) {
	// M6 ×1
	db.Select().From("t").Where(relica.Like("f", "_x").EscapeChars()).All(nil)
}

// M7 ×1
const dsn = "data.db?mode=ro"

func v1(db *relica.DB) {
	// V1 ×3: expression, NULLS LAST, two columns in one string (the last one in chain style)
	db.Select("id").From("t").OrderBy("salary + 1 DESC").All(nil)
	db.Select("id").From("t").OrderBy("due ASC NULLS LAST").All(nil)
	db.Select("id").From("t").
		OrderBy("a DESC, b").
		All(nil)
}

func v2(db *relica.DB) {
	// V2 ×2: a literal, DISTINCT inside the column string
	db.Select("1").From("t").All(nil)
	db.Select("id").AndSelect("DISTINCT name").From("t").All(nil)
}

func v3(db *relica.DB) {
	// V3 ×1
	db.Select("n").From("t").GroupBy("a + b").All(nil)
}

func v4(db *relica.DB) {
	// V4 ×2: single line, and a chain with the dot at the end of the line
	db.Delete("sessions").Execute()
	db.Update("t").
		Set(map[string]any{"a": 1}).
		Execute()
}

func v4more(db *relica.DB) error {
	// V4 ×2 more: a multi-line argument inside the chain, and a chain in an if
	db.Update("u").
		Set(map[string]any{
			"a": 1,
		}).
		Execute()
	if _, err := db.Delete("v").Execute(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func v5(q *relica.Query) {
	// V5 ×1 (QueryParams is left to the compiler)
	relica.NewDB("postgres", "dsn")
	_ = q.QueryParams()
}

func v6(db *relica.DB) {
	// V6 ×1
	db.Upsert("t", map[string]any{"id": 1}).OnConflict("id").Execute()
}

func v7(tx *relica.Tx) {
	// V7 ×1
	tx.Select().From("t").ForUpdate().All(nil)
}

// V8 ×2: an untagged exported field and an embedded struct next to db tags
type Audit struct{ By string }

type Row struct {
	Audit
	ID        int `db:"id"`
	CreatedAt string
}

func v9(db *relica.DB, r *Row) {
	// V9 ×1 (INFO): Row has db tags and no TableName, and the repo uses Model
	db.Model(r).Insert()
}

func v10(db *relica.DB) {
	// V10 ×1
	db.Select("dept").From("t").GroupBy("dept").Count()
}

func i5(db *relica.DB, sort string) {
	// I5 ×1
	db.Select().From("t").OrderBy(sort).All(nil)
}

func i6(db *relica.DB, r Row) {
	// I6 ×1
	db.UpdateStruct("t", r).Where(relica.Eq("id", 1)).Execute()
}

// I8 ×1
var hook = relica.WithQueryHook(nil)

func i1i2i3i4(db *relica.DB) {
	db.Select("*").From("t").All(nil)                     // I1 ×1
	db.Builder().Select().From("t").All(nil)             // I2 ×1
	db.Insert("t", map[string]any{"a": 1}).Execute()     // I3 ×1
	relica.WrapDB(nil, "postgres")                       // I4 ×1
}
